# Embedded Emissions: Semi-finished Steel Billets from India

**Total embedded emissions: 1,189.08 tCO2e**

## Inputs

| Required input | Value | In table? |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | Yes |
| (b) Country of production | India | Yes, listed for 7207 11 90 |
| (c) Quantity | 275.25 t | Provided |

All three required inputs are present, so the figure can be computed.

## Default SEE Selected

The SEE is selected by the pair (CN 7207 11 90, India), which gives **4.32 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 4.32 tCO2e/t × 275.25 t
= **1,189.08 tCO2e**

**Note:** The scenario gives India as the "origin." I have treated this as the country of production, as the ruleset requires. If the goods were produced elsewhere and only shipped from India, a different default value would apply.
